---
title: "Localised list titles"
lang: fr
lof: true
lot: true
crossref:
  lot-title: "Mes tableaux"
format: typst
_quarto:
  tests:
    typst:
      ensurePdfRegexMatches:
        - # French default title for figures, crossref override for tables
          - 'Liste des Figures[\s\S]*Une figure[\s\S]*Mes tableaux[\s\S]*Un tableau'
        - - 'List of Figures'   # English default must not leak through
          - 'Liste des Tables'  # crossref lot-title must win over the language title
---

# Introduction

With `lang: fr`, the figure list takes its title from the French language file, while `crossref: lot-title` replaces the language title of the table list.
